verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm and platform. A provider like this could plausibly offer accelerator, YC or VC-portfolio partnerships or founder pricing, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only general pricing claims (no billable hours, one clear price) and visa guides, such as the International Entrepreneur Parole article. Nothing describes YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents startup-ecosystem programs — YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing
